entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: The one made of five, a person who exists only five times across the Rabiahs, destined to become the most powerful sorcerer ever known.

entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: An inhuman sorceress who seeks to unite the five Taysirs to become queen of all Rabiahs.

entities.name: Raghib
entities.description: A leper cursed by Nailah, her betrothed and former pawn, who helps the Dervish.

entities.name: El-Hajjâj
entities.description: Nailah's father, who sought to protect the last Taysir and is killed by Nailah.

entities.name: Shahrazad
entities.description: Namesake of the letters page Shahrazad's Tales.

entities.name: Ring of Ma'Rûf
entities.description: A ring used to seek out and travel to other copies of Taysir.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: One of thousands of planes, of which only five hold a Taysir.

entities.name: Fa'adiyah
entities.description: The forest where the comic opens with a murder.

entities.name: Karun
entities.description: A desert where the Nomad Taysir was living.

entities.name: Bazaar of Bassorah
entities.description: The bazaar where the Dervish lives alongside Raghib.

entities.name: Castle of El-Hajjâj
entities.description: A castle that appears submerged in a lake through an illusion, holding the City in a Bottle.

entities.name: Unification of Taysir
entities.description: The merging of the five Taysirs into one.

events.summary: A well-dressed man murders an unarmed man in the forest of Fa'adiyah; the survivor mixes blood with the dead man and is overwhelmed by his memories, and Nailah calls him her Apprentice.
events.quote: She addresses him as her Apprentice and admonishes him for his weakness.

events.summary: Nailah and the Apprentice use the Ring of Ma'Rûf to find the Nomad Taysir; the Apprentice rebels, gives the Ring to the Nomad and attacks Nailah.
events.quote: He thrusts the Ring into the Nomad's hands

events.summary: The Nomad reaches the Bazaar of Bassorah and finds the Dervish with Raghib, who blames Nailah for his leprosy.
events.quote: Raghib recognizes the Ring and blames Nailah for inflicting leprosy upon him after he betrayed her.

events.summary: Nailah imprisons the Apprentice in an oubliette and reveals she wants the united Taysir to make her queen of all Rabiahs.
Nailah tempts the Nomad to slay the Dervish, but he refuses and attacks her; gravely wounded, he tells the Dervish to take his life and escape to find the last Taysir.
events.quote: Nailah appears and tempts the Nomad to slay the Dervish.

events.summary: The Dervish and Raghib reach the castle of El-Hajjâj, where Raghib exposes the water as an illusion.
events.quote: Raghib touches the water and recognizes it as an illusion

events.summary: Raghib reveals that El-Hajjâj is Nailah's father and that Nailah compelled Raghib to help betray him.
events.quote: He says that El-Hajjâj was Nailah's father

events.summary: The Dervish opens the city in a bottle and, urged by El-Hajjâj, sacrifices the Baby Taysir within.
Nailah kills El-Hajjâj and Raghib and wounds the Apprentice; the Dervish blasts her and merges with the Apprentice, becoming the complete Taysir.
events.quote: She kills El-Hajjâj and Raghib, and wounds the Apprentice

events.summary: Taysir planeswalks away from Nailah, who bars him from returning to any plane of Rabiah.
events.quote: Nailah enacts her final revenge, barring Taysir from returning to any of the many planes of Rabiah.

relations.note: seeks to use the united Taysir
relations.quote: She reveals her intent to use the fully-united Taysir

relations.note: compelled to assist her as her pawn
relations.quote: his final act as her pawn was to bring the Apprentice Taysir to her
